 Series Notes
 The Suns and Magic split their season series in 2025-26 as each team won on their home court
 Phoenix and Orlando played in a double-overtime contest on Feb. 21, 2026, the Suns' first 2OT game since Nov. 19, 2023. Jalen Green hit a game winning three-pointer as time expired, giving Phoenix a 113-110 win
 Key Connections
 Magic guard Jevon Carter was a member of the Suns from 2019-21, appearing 118 times and was a part of Phoenix's NBA Finals run in 2021
 Magic guard Desmond Bane was teammates with Suns guard/forward Dillon Brooks , Suns guard Luke Kennard and Suns guard Jordan Goodwin with the Memphis Grizzlies
 Suns center Mark Williams and Magic forward Paolo Banchero were teammates at Duke during the 2021-22 season, reaching the Final Four
 Magic AC Joe Prunty held the same position in Phoenix during the 2018-19 season
 Magic AC Josh Broghamer began his NBA coaching career as a video intern for the Suns during the 2013-14 season

 #15 – Devin Booker LAST GAME : Put up a game-best 33 points vs. Portland

 Notes
 The Suns fell to 1-5 against the Trail Blazers on Nov. 4 in the beginning leg of Phoenix's first back-to-back of the season.
 DEVIN BOOKER tallied a game-high 33 points and is now one appearance away from tying Steve Nash for the third-most games in franchise history. Booker went 13-for-13 FT and has now knocked down 25 consecutive free throws across the last three games.
 MILES BRIDGES posted 18 points, 7 rebounds, 5 assists and 2 steals. He now has 63 points, 23 rebounds, 10 assists, 7 steals and 4 blocks in his last three games, the first Suns player to post those numbers in a three-game span since Amar'e Stoudemire in 2008.
 JALEN GREEN ended with 22 points and 2 blocks. Green has tallied multiple blocks in consecutive games for the first time in his NBA
 career.
 DILLON BROOKS recorded 15 points and 6 rebounds. Brooks has posted 15+ points in five of six contests this season and has 1,230 points in his first 62 games with the Suns.
 Team Leaders by Points Per Game
 24.7 pts Devin Booker 15 | G 17.3 pts Miles Bridges 22 | F 16.5 pts Dillon Brooks 3 | GF See more stats Last Game Recap
 PHOENIX - The Suns (1-5) fell to the Trail Blazers, 132-119, at home on Nov. 4. Phoenix won the first quarter 34-29 thanks to 12 points from Devin Booker , who went 4-of-6 from the field. Portland responded with a 43-point second quarter, taking a 72-59 lead into the break. The Trail Blazers had three players score in double figures in the first half. Booker totaled 19 points and Dillon Brooks put up 11 points before the break for Phoenix. Portland took its largest lead of the game in the third quarter, a 22-point advantage, and outscored the Suns by six points in the period. Booker scored all of his game-high 33 points in the first three quarters. The Trail Blazers, who shot 51.2 FG%, had a better field goal percentage, three-point percentage, more rebounds and assists than the Suns. Despite the loss, the Suns forced 18 Portland turnovers that turned into 21 points for Phoenix. Jalen Green (22) and Miles Bridges (18) joined Booker and Bridges in double figures for the Suns.
